item.title: Mocelin: Friends
item.description: A fire can start in seconds. Built on this simple truth, Mocelin created a print campaign drawing a parallel between a phrase that sparks conflict and a real fire—showing that in both cases, acting in time changes everything. VIEW THE 3 ADS

item.title: Colectivo Cabos: Ocean Fireworks
item.description: A New Year's celebration can look very different depending on where you stand. What feels like a moment of joy for some happens out of sight for others. This is an invitation for us to shift our point of view and look beneath the surface. To reveal the invisible impact certain traditions leave on the ocean. And to rethink how we celebrate when we remember we share the planet. VIEW THE 3 ADS

item.title: Chevrolet: Every Mile Counts
item.description: Let’s be honest: when you open a gift, you never stop to ask, "How did this get here?" You just want to use it.But with Buses y Camiones Chevrolet Ecuador and Camiones Chevrolet Chile, here at Garnier BBDO Ecuador®, we wanted to flip the script.We didn't want to do the typical "Merry Christmas" print ad with three trucks parked in a row, so we focused on the human side. Our story is that the journey matters just as much as the destination. And I think we really nailed that "mission accomplished"

item.title: Bic: Inkredible
item.description: For BIC Cristal, we built the campaign around one Inkredible truth: every pen writes up to three kilometres. From there, we repositioned Cristal as more than an everyday pen - it’s a design icon. Unchanged since inception, sold in the billions and recognised in MoMA’s permanent collection, the campaign celebrated that the BIC Cristal is, Inkredible! VIEW THE 3 SPOTS

item.title: Heinz: The Bite
item.description: We’ve all felt it: that strange, irrational urge to bite the things we love. A kitten. A baby’s foot. A partner’s arm… even a ketchup sachet. Science calls it tender aggression: a psychological response that helps humans release emotion when affection becomes overwhelming. Biting isn’t violence; it’s an instinctive way of expressing love.What if biting a Heinz ketchup sachet wasn’t just about getting the ketchup out, but a way of showing affection? Heinz redefines this everyday, VIEW THE 2 SPOTS

item.title: Comfitables Diapers: Good To Go
item.description: Nearly 3.1 million dogs are surrendered annually to animal shelters within the U.S. About 600,000 of those cases are linked to incontinence and potty accident-related issues.Dog diapers and wraps can be literal lifesavers, but these products are often considered taboo, especially in public. Pet parents fear they will be judged as lazy or that something is wrong with their furry friends. item.title: Govt.Of Chile: Conaset Mateo A Good Guy
item.description: “Mateo, a good guy” is a road safety campaign promoted by the Government of Chile, that offers a different perspective on responsible driving. The story focuses on a familiar, everyday character, someone widely perceived as a good person, to show how a small decision behind the wheel can lead to irreversible consequences.Developed by TV social streaming and built from close observation of everyday life, the campaign avoids a didactic tone and instead relies on identification as the main trigger

item.title: Hard Rated: Born Cheeky
item.description: Hard Rated alcoholic lemon was born from the cheeky mix of real lemons and yummy alcohol. VIEW OUTDOOR

item.title: Solca: Medicine Person
item.description: For our New Year edition, we remind people that by sharing a little of their time, they can become medicine-person for cancer patients VIEW THE AD

item.title: Yokohama City School For the Visually Impaired: Mt Fuji
item.description: The defining characteristic of the Yokohama City Special Support School for the Visually Impaired is its genuine commitment to responding to the fine gradations of each student’s visual impairment and individuality. From teaching materials to lesson plans, the school implements truly meticulous and creative adaptations tailored to every single person. VIEW THE AD
